explication: Computer Use Preview is a CLI-driven browser agent: a user supplies a task, the agent asks Gemini for computer-use actions, dispatches those actions to a selected browser backend, and sends the resulting page state back into the interaction. Playwright provides local browser control; Browserbase reuses its computer behavior over a remotely hosted browser session. The excerpts show the CLI wiring, agent/model interaction, and backend calls; finer-grained behavior inside the unsampled agent loop is not expanded here.
